# zusvg

The goal of zusvg is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of zusvg from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zusvg")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(zusvg)
## basic example code
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`svg_load()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_load.md)
  : Load an SVG document
- [`svg_read()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_read.md)
  : Read an SVG file
- [`svg_size()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_size.md)
  : Size of an SVG document
- [`svg_validate()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_validate.md)
  : Check that a document loads
- [`zusvg-conditions`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/zusvg-conditions.md)
  : Conditions raised by zusvg
- [`zusvg_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/zusvg_info.md)
  : Build information
